task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First step, retrieve the Microsoft latchkey from the board. And then, check that the Microsoft locker within the steam room is unlocked with the Microsoft latchkey. Then, ensure that the Microsoft locker is open. If you have pulled open the Microsoft locker, retrieve the keycard from the Microsoft locker in the steam room. After that, insert the keycard into the door's lock to unlock it. And then, look and see that the door is opened. Having opened the door, attempt to venture east. And then, make an effort to travel north. And then, make an attempt to travel east. Following that, make an attempt to venture south. Then, venture east. And then, head north. And then, make an effort to travel north. Next, attempt to go to the north. After that, venture west. Okay, and then, attempt to head west. After that, attempt to take a trip west. Then, pick up the fondue from the floor of the studio. That's it!
